chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Clothing Industrial School in Cincinnati
summary: He studied tailoring at night at the Clothing Industrial School and worked days at the motor company until 1927.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And then you left, after playing at the Eighty-One and the rooftop and around Atlanta, you left and then came to Cincinnati?
And in Cincinnati, what did you do?
He went back to school, tailoring school.
What school was that? Do you remember? The name of the school in Cincinnati?
Oh, that was the Clothing Industrial School. That's the name of it... (SEVERAL VOICES) Yeah, that's when I was taken care of.
Stella - another sister - she went there too. She was going to _____ also.
How long did he remain in the school there?
How long did you stay in the school in Cincinnati?
Mm, off and on, let's see, I went and I came back - the last time I stayed there about - I left in 1927 and I stayed there about a year, because I was playing with Wes Helvey's band.
Did you - did they have a school band at the Industrial School?
No, no, no... I just took tailoring there. I was taking tailoring at night, going to night school.
What did you do during the day?
I worked for the Jenning (illegible) Motor Company.
